stem: Voltmarkt's RFM run as of 30 September 2026 covers the known customers who ordered in the past 12 months. Together they spent €3.2M in that time. The 640 customers in the best segment, with R, F and M all 4 or higher, spent €1.12M of it. What share of the known customers' 12-month spend comes from the best segment? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
